_comment: Manifest-driven catalog. status: supported | deprecated | planned | blocked. Deprecation is data: a 'deprecated' entry stays visible with its reason and successor. 'prereq' is a command that must exit 0, otherwise the runner is reported as not installed (never as failed). Runners marked build_state 'first-draft' were written without being able to install the library; the first real run decides.

runners.note: Control: the same flow without any library. If this passes and a library fails, the library or its use is the cause.
Generic OAuth2: does not validate ID tokens (library design, per its documentation); the runner checks iss and aud itself, as an application would have to.
runners.install: cd runners/node/passport-oauth2 && npm install   (needs the on-site registry)

runners.note: Refuses to build a login request unless it signs it, because Keycloak's descriptor says WantAuthnRequestsSigned=true. Teams need an SP key pair and its certificate registered on the Keycloak client. Not a version change (same on 26.0.8, 26.2.5, 26.6.4). Needs a schema validator since 2.6; the runner uses @authenio/samlify-node-xmllint if installed and reports which one it used.
Needs native lxml/xmlsec (on RHEL 9: xmlsec1 packages); on Windows a prebuilt python-xmlsec wheel.

OIDC through the generic OAuth plugin, in-memory storage. npm install on Node 18 warns: kysely needs Node >= 22, nanostores >= 20, @noble/* >= 20.19 (EBADENGINE). Treat Node 18 as an unsupported combination. The SAML side (SSO plugin) is a later variant. In 1.7 the generic OAuth plugin uses the core social sign-in endpoints; the redirect URI is /api/auth/callback/<providerId> (not /oauth2/callback/...). A team upgrading from an older better-auth must change the registered redirect URI. Also in 1.7: getAccessToken and refreshToken no longer accept {providerId}; they need the library's account id or {useAccountCookie:true}, so code written for earlier versions fails with 'Invalid input'.

deprecation.action: Upgrade the library; teams on older versions should plan it now.

runners.note: Catalog entry only, no runner: shows how a library version is marked deprecated without changing code.
